prompt: STRICT TEXTURE-ONLY NATURALIZATION EDIT of an evidence reconstruction. The reference is the locked topology authority. Preserve EVERY footprint's position, count, grouping, direction, and overhead 16:9 framing. It contains exactly FOUR sauropod trackway corridors. Each corridor has exactly TWO laterally separated parallel rails (total eight rails), with an untouched central mud strip visible between its left and right rail. Each rail has four alternating manus-pes sets: a large oval hind-foot impression and a smaller crescent forefoot impression just ahead. Preserve the half-stride left/right staggering. Also preserve exactly ONE diagonal theropod trail of nine large, separated tridactyl prints. Do not merge rails, delete prints, add prints, change any trail, or turn them into four single centerlines. Change ONLY rendering quality: make the diagram-like impressions look physically pressed into the same wet Middle Jurassic limestone mud, with irregular compressed rims, subtle slumped edges, shallow pooled water, displaced silt, and varied natural depth. Reduce graphic outlines and repeated stamp appearance while keeping the topology unambiguous. Strict vertical orthographic plan view. No dinosaur bodies, people, labels, arrows, text, horizon, modern tire marks, or fossil slab. Evidence-led, natural museum reconstruction, copyright-safe original.
overlayWorkflow: The generated naturalized base retained four sauropod corridors with two rails each but omitted the crossing theropod trail. The project-authored compose_trackway_evidence_plate.mjs script added exactly nine broad tridactyl impressions on one diagonal path. The overlay does not reproduce surveyed footprint coordinates or claim track order.
